MR PETER KUNG: Mr J C H Ho (Stipendiary Steward)
REFUSETOBEENGLISH: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was checked to avoid WELL ENOUGH.  Near the 400 Metres was steadied to avoid JUMBO STEPS.
GLORIOUS JOURNEY: Shortly after the start was crowded by HAPPY PROMISE which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
VIVA GRACIOUSNESS: Apprentice P N Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 1400 Metres (see MISSION GIANT).  Apprentice Wong could offer no excuse for her mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RAGGA BOMB: Near the 600 Metres was steadied when carried wider by HAPPY PROMISE (A Atzeni) which shifted out when not sufficiently clear.  A Atzeni was severely reprimanded.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of R Kingscote, 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.  Trainer D Eustace confirmed that from the outside barrier he had instructed R Kingscote to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages as it raced too keenly at its most recent start when it raced in a forward position.
WELL ENOUGH: Shortly after the start became badly unbalanced when bumped heavily by MISSION GIANT.  When being shifted in leaving the 1600 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid GLORIOUS JOURNEY.
ACE: Leaving the 1100 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded by I AM BACK (E C W Wong) which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  E C W Wong was advised to exercise more care.  Leaving the 500 Metres raced tight to the inside of I AM BACK which shifted in slightly when giving ground.  Bumped near the 150 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
JUMBO STEPS: Crowded approaching the 1400 Metres.  E C W Wong (I AM BACK) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1300 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of JUMBO STEPS, resulting in JUMBO STEPS having to be checked.  E C W Wong was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 and to expire on Thursday, 5 November 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (3 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Jockey Wong was fined $50,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very poor race riding record.  Approaching the 400 Metres raced tight between GLORIOUS JOURNEY and I AM BACK which was giving ground.  Near the 400 Metres was checked to avoid MISSION GIANT which lost ground when being checked.  K C Leung advised that from a wide barrier he was instructed to take up a forward position as connections were of the opinion there was a lack of pace engaged in the event.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
I AM BACK: Crowded approaching the 1400 Metres.  E C W Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 1300 Metres (see JUMBO STEPS).  Jockey Wong stated that from his wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He said when his mount commenced well and raced keenly he was obliged to allow it to stride forward.  He said I AM BACK continued to race keenly in the early and middle stages before giving ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of I AM BACK, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, I AM BACK will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
HAPPY PROMISE: Shifted out at the start and made contact with GLORIOUS JOURNEY.  When placed under pressure in the Home Straight lay in and near the 150 Metres shifted in and made contact with ACE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
INNO SUPER: Withdrawn on 20.10.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind).  Before being allowed to race again, INNO SUPER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP: Near the 950 Metres shifted out and made contact with RUNJEET.
CASA PRIMO: Jumped only fairly and from a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 250 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of VERBIER to continue into clear running.  When questioned regarding his riding out of the horse B Avdulla stated that when placed under pressure in the early stages of the Home Straight his mount lay out.  He said for this reason near the 100 Metres he changed his whip through to his left hand in order to correct his mount, however, CASA PRIMO then shifted in which resulted in his level of vigour decreasing for a short distance as he approached the finish of the event.  He added when he was satisfied he was always holding third placing from GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP he continued to encourage his horse to the finish of the race without having to fully test it.  B Avdulla was advised, wherever possible, he should ensure he places the appropriate amount of vigour to his mounts to ensure he does not compromise their placings in the race.
AUTUMN VIBES: Jumped awkwardly and made contact with the left side of the starting gate.  Near the 450 Metres was steadied when racing tight to the inside of GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP (Z Purton) which was being ridden along to hold its position to the inside of ICONICAL (L Hewitson).  Both Jockeys Purton and Hewitson were advised to exercise more care.  L Ferraris could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FALCON HUNTER: Brushed near the 150 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ALWAYS MY FOLKS: Shortly after the start was eased to avoid VERBIER which shifted out slightly.  K C Leung reported that he was instructed to take up a midfield position preferably with cover.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he endeavoured to restrain his mount to obtain cover but ALWAYS MY FOLKS raced too keenly and as a consequence was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
VERBIER: Near the 150 Metres shifted in and made slight contact with FALCON HUNTER.  J Orman stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Trainer C Fownes confirmed the instructions and stated he issued those instructions as VERBIER had not been finishing its races off when racing in a forward position and the horse had raced with success when being ridden more conservatively previously.  Sent for sampling post-race.
NOBLE FANS: Approaching the 200 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between AUTUMN VIBES and ICONICAL, both of which shifted ground slightly.  As a result NOBLE FANS was held up for clear running until near the 150 Metres.
RUNJEET: Bumped on the hindquarters on jumping.  Near the 950 Metres was hampered when crowded between ICONICAL and GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP which shifted out after being corrected by its rider Z Purton.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CHILL MASTER: Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with RUNJEET and as a result became unbalanced.  Held up for clear running making the Home Turn.  Over the final 50 Metres lay in when racing tight to the inside of GOLDEN FRIENDSHIP.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HAPPY BUDDIES: M F Poon could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
URANUS STAR: When questioned Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that her instructions were to go forward and lead.  She said although URANUS STAR commenced well she was obliged to make use of the horse in the early stages to cross LUCK IS BACK and LUCKY MY WAY.  She said approaching the first turn she then attempted to restrain URANUS STAR after crossing to the rail, however, URANUS STAR commenced to race keenly.  She said although she was aware that URANUS STAR was racing well inside standard time she was unable to set a slower pace due to the manner in which the horse was racing.  She added after entering the Home Straight URANUS STAR gave ground due to racing too keenly.  After considering her explanation the Stewards were satisfied that Apprentice Yuen was riding to instructions in the early stages and that URANUS STAR would not respond to her efforts to set a slower pace during the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HAPPY SMILE: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with AESTHETICISM.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TAKE ACTION: On jumping shifted in and made contact with RISING FROM EAST.  Near the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid HAPPY SMILE (K C Leung) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  K C Leung was reprimanded.
STRANGE ALERT: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
RISING FROM EAST: Crowded at the start.   Bumped near the 500 Metres.  R Kingscote stated that his mount weakened noticeably in the Home Straight and would appreciate a surface with more give in it.  The performance of RISING FROM EAST, which had finished tailed out on two consecutive occasions, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, RISING FROM EAST will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in two consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LUCK IS BACK: Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
AESTHETICISM: Bumped at the start.  From a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 100 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of LUCKY MY WAY to continue into clear running.
FORTUNE STAR: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 500 Metres shifted in and made contact with RISING FROM EAST.
LUCKY MCQUEEN: M F Poon confirmed the instructions were to endeavour to hold a midfield position with cover.  He said when caught wide from the outside barrier he was obliged to settle towards the back of the field to ensure that his mount obtained cover.
MASTER RESOLUTE: After travelling a short distance was steadied when crowded between MATZDEN and LIGHTNESS OF BEING (Y L Chung) which shifted in.  Approaching the 1000 Metres MASTER RESOLUTE was then steadied to avoid LIGHTNESS OF BEING which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  Y L Chung was advised to exercise more care in respect of both incidents.
MATZDEN: Near the 200 Metres was eased to avoid VIRTUS GLORY (Apprentice H Y Yuen) which shifted in before being corrected.  Apprentice Yuen was advised to exercise more care and in similar circumstances to straighten her mounts sooner than what she did on this occasion.
VIRTUS GLORY: When questioned Apprentice H Y Yuen confirmed her instructions were to go forward and attempt to lead.  She said although VIRTUS GLORY jumped well, when a number of runners to her inside showed better speed she did not continue forward to contest the lead.  She said her decision to do so was also on the basis that she was of the opinion it was advantageous to position the horse with cover having regard to tonight’s track pattern.  Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions were to lead.  Noted to be displaying mild signs of "thumps” after the race.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HARVEST MOON: Shifted out abruptly on jumping and made heavy contact with SHOW ME YOUR LOVE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VIGOR FLY: Jumped only fairly and then raced tight to the inside of MASTER PHOENIX which shifted in.  Making the Home Turn became unbalanced when racing tight to the inside of FLYING TING LOK.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind LIGHTNESS OF BEING.
MASTER PHOENIX: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  The Stewards considered a protest/objection lodged by Mr D Eustace, trainer of the 3rd placegetter, MASTER PHOENIX, against FLYING TING LOK (Apprentice P N Wong) being declared the 2nd placegetter alleging interference on the Home Turn.  After taking evidence from the parties concerned the Stewards found that FLYING TING LOK shifted out near the 350 Metres when not sufficiently clear of MASTER PHOENIX, resulting in MASTER PHOENIX being checked to avoid FLYING TING LOK, shifting out and losing ground.  The Stewards were satisfied that had this incident not have occurred MASTER PHOENIX would have finished in advance of FLYING TING LOK.  Therefore the protest/objection was sustained and the placings amended to read No. 4, VIRTUS GLORY, 1st; No. 7, MASTER PHOENIX, 2nd; No. 8, FLYING TING LOK, 3rd; and No. 2, MASTER RESOLUTE, 4th.  At a subsequent inquiry Apprentice P N Wong pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 350 Metres she allowed her mount to shift out when insufficiently clear of MASTER PHOENIX, resulting in MASTER PHOENIX being taken out and having to be checked to avoid FLYING TING LOK.  Apprentice Wong was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 22 November 2026 and to expire on Thursday, 26 November 2026 on which day she may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered her good race riding record.  Sent for sampling post-race.
FLYING TING LOK: On jumping was bumped heavily on the hindquarters by SHOW ME YOUR LOVE and became badly unbalanced.  Apprentice P N Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 350 Metres (see MASTER PHOENIX).  Relegated to 3rd placing on protest/objection (see MASTER PHOENIX).
SHOW ME YOUR LOVE: On jumping was checked when crowded by HARVEST MOON which shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.
HIGH RISE VICTORY: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LIGHTNESS OF BEING: Y L Chung stated that the instructions were to be midfield.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to continue forward and lead the event to avoid covering additional ground.
FREE PONY: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was steadied to avoid MASTER RESOLUTE which shifted out and away from MATZDEN.  Approaching the 200 Metres improved into a run between SHOW ME YOUR LOVE and HARVEST MOON (A Atzeni) which shifted in when racing greenly.  As a result FREE PONY was then checked when crowded by HARVEST MOON.  A Atzeni was reprimanded and advised he must make a greater effort to prevent his mounts from shifting ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GEORGIAN SIGMA: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
COPPER CORE: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 500 Metres was eased when MAPOGO was taken in slightly by KING ALLOY.
COLOURFUL GOLD: Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by MAPOGO which shifted out.
FLOW RIDER: Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was steadied to avoid IRON SECURITY which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.  When placed under pressure in the Home Straight raced greenly and near the 100 Metres shifted in and made contact with SYNERGY IN ACTION.
IRON SECURITY: Shifted out shortly after the start and made contact with FLOW RIDER.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid KING ALLOY when obtaining a position with cover.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had some difficulty obtaining clear running.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LEAN FLYER: H Bentley stated that the intention was to be more forward but his mount failed to show sufficient pace.  He said in the Home Straight LEAN FLYER failed to respond to his riding and was disappointing.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of LEAN FLYER was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, LEAN FLYER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SYNERGY IN ACTION: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Near the 100 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between MASTER CHAMPION and FLOW RIDER which shifted in and made contact with SYNERGY IN ACTION.
SUPER SIXTY: Lay in under pressure in the Home Straight.  Sent for sampling post-race.
KING ALLOY: M L Yeung stated that he had to make use of his mount to cross runners to his inside in the early stages and after being pressured in the lead KING ALLOY was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MAPOGO: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SUPERB CAPITALIST: Y L Chung stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position and when his mount jumped only fairly and did not show sufficient early pace it settled further back than intended.
LOVE TOGETHER: Shortly after the start made contact with SIGHT HERMOSO.  After travelling a short distance made contact with GLOWING PRAISES due to both runners shifting ground.  A Badel stated that he was unable to cross runners to his inside in the early stages and as a consequence his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event where it hung out.  Trainer C Fownes advised the horse had pleased him leading into the race and stated that LOVE TOGETHER was disadvantaged by being caught wide and the manner in which it raced throughout the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
GLOWING PRAISES: After travelling a short distance made contact with LOVE TOGETHER due to both runners shifting ground.
CANDLELIGHT DINNER: Hung in under pressure in the Home Straight.
HEALTHY HEALTHY: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
GOLDEN ACE: Lay in when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  B Avdulla reported that after settling back in the field and the early and middle stages of the race being run outside of standard time his mount finished the race off reasonably well and he was satisfied with its performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KOL: After being crossed by TOP TO SKY near the 800 Metres commenced to race keenly and shifted out when being steadied to avoid TOP TO SKY.  When under pressure near the 200 Metres was steadied when crowded between HEALTHY HEALTHY and MALPENSA, both of which shifted ground.  Z Purton stated that his mount, which was having its first race start at Happy Valley, raced ungenerously and would derive benefit from tonight’s experience on the Happy Valley circuit.  Trainer D A Hayes stated that he had expected the horse to perform well, particularly as it had previously trialed at Happy Valley.  He said subsequent to the comments of Jockey Purton he would now look to start the horse at Sha Tin at its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPICY BONUS: Jumped only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HERO MASTERMIND: In the early and middle stages raced keenly and near the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid GOLDEN ACE.  L Hewitson advised that from the outside barrier his instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner, particularly as HERO MASTERMIND was having its first race start at Happy Valley.  Trainer M Newnham confirmed the instructions issued.
ENJOY GOLF: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FORZA LEADER: For a short distance approaching the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
PERFECT GENERAL: Shortly after the start was checked when crowded by LUCKY RIVER which jumped awkwardly and then shifted in.
KYRUS DRAGON: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
JUBILANT WINNER: Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.
GREATER BAE: Shortly after the start was crowded between JUBILANT WINNER and PERFECT GENERAL.  Near the 200 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of LUCKY RIVER to continue into clear running.  L Ferraris stated that after being crowded shortly after the start his mount settled further back in the field than what had been intended.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ROYAL BLITZ: When questioned Z Purton stated that it was not the intention to lead.  He said after riding his mount along in the early stages to hold an on-pace position ROYAL BLITZ commenced to race keenly and as a result he was obliged to allow it to stride forward to lead.  He added that when placed under pressure in the Home Straight his mount did not respond to his riding.  He said when he was concerned there was something amiss with the horse he did not ride it out over the final 150 Metres.  Trainer D J Whyte stated that the horse, in his opinion, was not suited by being ridden in the lead.  He added that at its next race start the horse will be ridden in a more conservative manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of ROYAL BLITZ was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, ROYAL BLITZ will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
LUCKY RIVER: Jumped awkwardly, resulting in its rider B Avdulla becoming unbalanced.  LUCKY RIVER then shifted in and made contact with PERFECT GENERAL.  B Avdulla reported that, in his opinion, the horse, which was racing first up, would derive a fitness benefit from tonight’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
PEGAS: Over the concluding stages raced tight to the inside of PERFECT GENERAL which shifted in slightly.
SMART OINK: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 1000 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied to avoid LEADING AGILITY which shifted in.  As a result SMART OINK shifted out, resulting in it making contact with DUKE ATREIDES.  Raced wide and without cover, and lay out on the Home Turn before giving ground in the Home Straight.
DUKE ATREIDES: Near the 1000 Metres was hampered when taken wider by SMART OINK which shifted out.
KING MILES: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
POPE CODY: Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
THE RED HARE: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SOLID WIN: When questioned regarding the horse racing in a more forward position as compared to its previous starts J Orman stated that from an inside barrier his mount jumped well.  He said he then elected to allow WIN METHOD to cross and follow that runner without having to apply any pressure to his mount to do so.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HIGHLAND RAHY: Raced wide and without cover until near the 750 Metres.  L Hewitson stated that the intention was to go forward and attempt to lead.  He said HIGHLAND RAHY jumped only fairly and despite being ridden along in the early stages did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.
PASS LINE: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
EMBRACES: When questioned regarding his riding making the Home Turn and in the early stages of the Home Straight and as to whether there was an opportunity to follow POPE CODY, C L Chau stated that after being positioned to the outside of POPE CODY his intention was to follow I CAN and FORZA TORO into the event.  He said when FORZA TORO did not improve as he had expected this resulted in EMBRACES being held up for clear running until near the 250 Metres.  He added whilst an opportunity presented to follow POPE CODY his instructions were to come to the outside and this was the main reason why he did not elect to follow POPE CODY.  Trainer W K Mo confirmed the instructions were to make a run to the outside in the Home Straight.
FORZA TORO: Jumped only fairly.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of E C W Wong, 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.  Jockey Wong stated that his instructions were to hold a handy position with cover.  He said his mount raced keenly throughout the event and as a result was left racing wide and without cover from the 750 Metres.
I CAN: C Y Ho reported that his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight and raced in a disappointing manner.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
WINDLORD: Withdrawn on 19.10.26 by order of the Stewards. (Promoted as a standby for the race meeting on 19 October 2026 after being entered for consecutive race meetings and trainer elected not to race on 21 October 2026).
